remarks: Fabulous Remodeled Townhouse in Norwalk - Spacious 2 Bed, 2.5 Bath with Private Patio. Welcome to your perfect home in Norwalk! This beautifully remodeled townhouse has 2 generously sized bedrooms, 2.5 modern bathrooms, and a spacious layout designed for comfort and convenience. The open-concept living and dining area features stylish finishes and plenty of natural light, perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The kitchen boasts updated stainless appliances, sleek granite countertops, and ample storage space. Upstairs, the primary bedroom includes a luxurious en-suite bath, while the second bedroom also has a full bathroom. Fully finished lower level has great additional space for entertaining or home office. Step outside to your private patio, ideal for morning coffee, evening BBQs, or simply unwinding in your own serene space. This townhouse also includes in-unit laundry, plenty of storage, and plenty of parking for your convenience. Located in a desirable Norwalk neighborhood and right on the Norwalk River Valley Trail, you're just minutes away from shopping, dining, parks, and transportation. Don't miss out on this stunning rental opportunity-schedule your tour today!
